result:
Done. The particle is in the spec and in the regenerated app, and it survives the repo's freshness gate.

**What the spec now contains** in `machtzev/generator/specs-ds/peruk12.txt`:

```
חלקיק תיק: אגרת העברה = [מספר] מחיר: אגרת העברת בעלות משולמת לפני הרישום
דוח תיק: אגרת העברה = אגרת העברה
```

`מחיר` is the only numeric field on the case entity, and a number particle must name a schema field, so it carries the value while the requested sentence is the note.

**Why the change was made at the source.** That spec file is emitted by the reader `peruk.mjs` from the owner document `peruks/peruk-12.md`, and the `peruk` police gate turns red when the spec on disk differs from what the reader emits. I verified that a plain hand edit fails that gate. So I made three changes:

- **Owner document.** Added an output item «אגרת העברה» under «מה חוזר» with `מחיר` on its line and the note on the next line. The last item was renumbered so its trailing «לא:» line still attaches to it.
- **Reader rule.** One narrow structural rule in `peruk.mjs`: an output item whose first detail line is exactly a numeric schema field label becomes a `[מספר]` particle with the rest as the note. Regenerating all 28 specs changed only peruk12.
- **Pin refresh.** The reader is signature pinned, so I refreshed its sha256 line.

**Evidence it works.**
- Baseline regeneration of the untouched spec produced zero diff, so the generator is deterministic.
- Particle plan lists the new particle as number ⇒ hero ⇒ KvLine, 7 of 7 wired, 0 unresolved.
- The px1 Dart screen gained the KvLine row and its import, the hub reads «7 חלקיקים חיים», and the report screen gained the section plus its text in the WhatsApp export string.
- Gates `peruk` and `particles` are green. The fast police run has every gate green except `learn`, which needs git blobs this shallow clone does not contain. That failure is pre-existing and unrelated.

Flutter is not installed, so no analyzer run. The report is at `_report.md`. No commits, pushes, or stashes were made.
